blocks.text: IBA, Zambales – A magnitude 4.6 earthquake was recorded near Zambales on Monday morning, according to the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs). The earthquake occurred at 8:54 a.m. at a depth of 10 kilometers, with the epicenter at 15.46°N, 119.47°E, or about 47 kilometers north of 86° west of Palauig town. READ: Magnitude
